triggerFailures.title: Trigger failures
triggerFailures.subtitle: Automations that ran and failed, across every app context in your account. A failure disappears once a later retry of the same firing succeeds — this shows what is currently broken, not a permanent history.
triggerFailures.timeRangeInvalid: Start time must be before end time.
triggerFailures.resultSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No failures} one {# failure} other {# failures}} loaded.
triggerFailures.idle: Fetch to see failed automations across your account, or narrow to one context first.
triggerFailures.emptyHint: Either nothing has failed recently, or your filters are narrower than any current failure.
triggerFailures.emptyPageMoreToSearch: No matches in the portion searched so far — there's more of your account left to check.
triggerFailures.searchFailed: We couldn't complete this search — part of your account was not searched. Try again.
triggerFailures.contextListUnavailable: We couldn't load the list of app contexts to search. Try again.
triggerFailures.incompleteWarning: This page could not be read for every context — some failures may be missing.
triggerFailures.incompletePartialPage: A page of results came back only partially read — try Load more or Refresh.
triggerFailures.contextsLoadError: We couldn't load your app contexts, so the context filter is unavailable. Please try again.
triggerFailures.internalErrorHint: Quote the correlation ID to support.
